title: Fonts used to train and test the tamil-tess-trainer Tamil models: tam_multifont (v1), tam_v2, tam_v3, tam_v3.1
lineage: Tesseract tessdata_best/tam -> tam_v2 -> tam_v3 -> tam_v3.1. tam_multifont (v1) was also fine-tuned from Tesseract's tam, but tam_v2 did not start from it, so fonts used only by v1 are not in the tam_v3.1 weights.

how_to_read.fonts: One entry per font style (one font file, or one setting of a variable font). The same file used by several models is one entry, matched by its SHA-256.
how_to_read.used_in: Per model: 'train' = rendered training lines were made with it; 'test only (held out)' = used only for test lines; train_lines / test_lines = rendered lines in this style (counts are not kept for tam_v3.1's training lines). tam_v3 used the same font list as tam_v2 and rendered new lines.
how_to_read.in_tam_v3_1_weights: true if the style was used to train tam_v2, tam_v3 or tam_v3.1, so it has influenced the tam_v3.1 weights. No font, image or text is stored inside any .traineddata file.
how_to_read.licence_recorded: The licence as recorded when the model was made.
how_to_read.licence_review: Findings of the licence review made for tam_v3.1 (where they differ from, or qualify, the record).

tam (Tesseract, base model).fonts: Not listed here. The base model was trained by the Tesseract project; this project has no record of its fonts.

tam_v3.1.also_trained_on: 16,012 of tam_v3's real scanned training lines (mixed 50/50 with the rendered lines)

not_included: tam_v2_research (V2-research, non-commercial research model, 276 styles): see models/tam_v2_research/fonts.json
corrections_and_notes: tam_v3.1 rendered test lines: until 25 Nov 2026 the model card, release notes, benchmark page, RESULTS.md and the pull requests described them as rendered in 6 fonts not used for training (corrected on that date). 4 of the 6 files (Noto Sans Tamil Condensed Regular, Noto Serif Tamil Slanted Regular, Uni Ila.Sundaram-19, TAU-Neythal; same SHA-256) were used to train tam_v2 and tam_v3, so they are in the tam_v3.1 weights. They were not used in tam_v3.1's own fine-tuning. Only Uni Ila.Sundaram-20 (held out in every version) and Latha (trained only in tam_multifont, which is not in the lineage) are unseen for tam_v3.1.

tam_v3.1: until 25 Nov 2026 MODEL_CARD.md and NOTICE said the training lines were rendered in '23 font files' (corrected on that date). fonts.tsv lists 24 (16 Tamil + 8 Latin). By the renderer's rule (03_render_lines.py: Latin font of the same class, same boldness and same slant as the Tamil font) only 20 can be picked: 16 Tamil + Noto Sans Regular/Bold + Noto Serif Regular/Bold. The 4 italic Latin files are never picked, because no Tamil training font is italic to fontconfig (Noto Serif Tamil Slanted reports slant 0). The per-line render records were deleted after training, so this count comes from the code, not from the records. Every render run reported 'fonts used outside the allowed list: none'.
tam_v2 / tam_v3: some recorded licences are unverified or differ from what the review found (Gopi, Akruti, Kadugu, Uni Ila.Sundaram, Tamil Virtual Academy fonts); see licence_review in each entry.
tam_multifont (v1) used 4 styles without an open licence (Latha, proprietary; uniAmma-10/11/16, unknown). They are not in the tam_v3.1 weights.
